title: Working hours and collaboration
body: Sample policy: Core collaboration hours are 10:00–15:00 on assigned workdays. Individual working schedules are confirmed by HR and line management; the agent cannot decide exceptions.

title: Annual leave request process
body: Sample policy: Submit annual leave requests via the HR case team for manager review. Individual balances, eligibility and leave entitlements must be checked by authorised HR staff.

title: New joiner onboarding
body: Sample policy: The onboarding checklist covers account setup, approved equipment, induction sessions and policy acknowledgement. Identity and employment files stay in restricted HR systems.

title: Hybrid and remote working
body: Sample policy: Hybrid and remote working arrangements require role suitability and a separate manager decision. The agent can explain the process but cannot approve the arrangement.

title: Office location and visitor process
body: Sample policy: Office-location information is maintained by Facilities. Employees and visitors should verify the approved directory before travelling, since locations may change.
